items.title: SSL/TLS - Keyless SSL supports TLS 1.3 with ECDSA certificates
items.summary:
Keyless SSL supports TLS 1.3 for ECDSA certificates. When TLS 1.3 is enabled on your zone, visitors connecting to a hostname that serves a Keyless ECDSA certificate negotiate TLS 1.3, and your private keys stay on your own key server.

Keyless SSL connections that use RSA certificates continue to negotiate up to TLS 1.2.
